commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+4' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee. Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
90+3' The referee is firm and issues Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) a deserved yellow card.
90+3' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Atl. Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Atl. Madrid will take a corner kick.
90+1' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Atl. Madrid have a free kick.
90+1' A quickly taken corner by Atl. Madrid.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid win a corner kick.
89' Alex Berenguer crosses and Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) misses a great opportunity with his head from close in, sending the ball just wide of the right post.
87' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
85' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jan Oblak intercepts the ball.
82' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Rodrigo de Paul and he is replaced by Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid).
82' The referee signals a substitution. Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Marcos Llorente.
81' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Inaki Williams will be replaced by Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
80' 3 - 1 Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
80' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) misses a great chance to score after his effort hits the left post!
79' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
77' Substitution. Angel Correa walks off the pitch and Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
76' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
75' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.
74' Total attempts – 6:6. The shots on goal statistics – 3:1.

72' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a precise cross from the free kick and produces a header at goal from the penalty spot, but his attempt towards the roof of the net fails to beat Unai Simon, who makes a fine save.
71' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
69' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta has picked up an injury and is replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
67' Here is a change. Nahuel Molina is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
66' We are about to witness a subsitution. Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) for Gorka Guruzeta.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) is coming onto the pitch as Yeray Alvarez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
66' Substitution. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) on for Oihan Sancet.
65' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
65' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
63' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
62' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
61' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
59' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) has tested the patience of referee Juan Martinez Munuera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
55' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

52' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) scores with a brilliant shot into the left side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Koke. The score is now 2:1.
50' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
49' The attendance for today's match is 64612.
47' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
46' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 1 - 1 Goal! Gorka Guruzeta puts the ball on a plate for Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 1:1.
45' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
43' Marcos Llorente finds Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
42' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
41' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
41' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Ath Bilbao win a corner.
40' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
39' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) works the corner short.

36' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta floats the corner into the six-yard box, but the ball spins off the head of Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) and falls to safety well wide of the left post.
31' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
30' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.

29' What a sensational goal that would have been! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) picks up the ball inside the box and fires a beautiful first-time shot, but it goes just a few inches wide of the right post.
27' 3:2 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 1:0.
23' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
23' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) jumps into a tackle and Juan Martinez Munuera signals a foul. Free kick. Ath Bilbao will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
19' The move breaks down when Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post.
17' No offside! Referee Juan Martinez Munuera points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Atl. Madrid players celebrate.
17' The Atl. Madrid players halt their celebrations as referee Juan Martinez Munuera makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
15' 1 - 0 Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Unai Simon. 1:0.
14' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
13' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
11' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
8' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough foul. Juan Martinez Munuera stops the game and makes a call.
6' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
5' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
5' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle after Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick.
4' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
4' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
2' Ath Bilbao keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Atl. Madrid will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
The referee of today's match will be Juan Martinez Munuera.
